subject: Physics
note: Medical/engineering/other specialisms are SEPARATE optional alternatives. 2021 Paper 3 student takes compulsory 7408/3A (45 marks) plus only ONE 35-mark Section B option. This file is source metadata only, not a complete student-visible question paper.
markingWarnings: 01.1 uses distinct linked explanations about moment of inertia and angular momentum; do not award conservation of rotational KE as an alternative.
01.2 is a single numerical mark that the official scheme explicitly allows without written working.
01.3 permits either angle-over-2π or time-per-rotation, with consequential credit; response must count completed rotations correctly.
01.4 comprises two distinct paired action-and-justification routes; a checklist of four disconnected keywords is unsafe.
02.1 separately assesses total energy balance, numerical substitution and answer; neglecting translational kinetic energy affects accuracy credit.
02.2 requires demonstrated substitution in a valid equation of rotational motion, not a bare formula.
03.1 is a six-mark LEVELS-OF-RESPONSE question combining a graph-derived multi-efficiency calculation and qualitative evaluation; cannot safely assign marks as six flat independent tick points.
03.2 needs a grounded comparison of plotted trends, not only a generic claim of lower power.
04.1 requires a sourced graph area, correct scaling, work comparison and conclusion; ECF may apply.
04.2 requires timescale and energy-transfer justification; generic 'process too fast' alone does not give all marks.
05.2 supports alternative valid energy ratios and thermal temperatures; method mark cannot be awarded for quoting a formula without a valid substitution.
verification: Checked all 12 parts and mark allocations against AQA November 2021 published question paper and final mark scheme using PDF screenshots; per-question marks 10+6+8+8+3=35. Skill labels are independent short paraphrases.
copyrightNote: Source IDs, marks, skill labels, page references and classification only; no copied original question wording, diagrams, answers or instructions to operate machinery.
